# Headband of Intellect (`magic-items:headband-of-intellect`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

Your Intelligence is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is 19 or higher without it.
